$comment: Licences of platform-specific optional packages that pnpm does not install on every machine (native bindings of oxfmt/oxlint/rolldown/lightningcss/TypeScript, fsevents, wasm runtime helpers). The SBOM generator reads licences from installed package.json files; for packages absent on this platform it falls back to these rules so the SBOM is identical everywhere. A rule that contradicts an installed sibling's licence makes `pnpm sbom` fail (stale rule). Add a rule only after reading the package's published licence.
